steps.text: Insert new filter(s) in the top of the body (Fig. 26). The current production service filter (stainless steel wire mesh pellet) is installed dimple end down, slotted end up. The former service filter (fiberglass-filled nylon cone) was installed with the pointed (cone) end up. Insert a new filter in the inlet side (located over the injector rack) in an offset injector. No filter is required at the outlet side (Fig. 27).
